title: Compartmental Protein Extraction for Enrichment of ECM Proteins
author: James Considine
materials: Sequential extraction of intracellular soluble proteins

Extraction of nuclear soluble proteins: Resuspend the pellet in 225 µL of Buffer NEB containing protease inhibitors. Incubate the sample on a tube rotator for 00:30:00 at 4 °C Buffer NEB containing protease inhibitors, CaCl 2 , and micrococcal nuclease should be taken off the ice at this point in preparation for step 2.4. Centrifuge the sample at 5.000 x g, , for 00:10:00 at 4 °C Collect the supernatant in a clean tube: this fraction is enriched for nuclear soluble (Nsol) proteins. Flash-freeze this fraction and store at -80 °C Aliquot 50 uL of the supernatant and add 25 uL of 3X Laemmli Buffer with 100 mM DTT to monitor the quality of the extraction by western blotting. Flash freeze and store at -80 C. Post extraction of nuclear soluble proteins pellet

Extraction of nuclear chromatin-bound proteins: Resuspend the pellet in 170 µL of Buffer NEB containing protease inhibitors, CaCl 2 , and micrococcal nuclease. Incubate the sample on a tube rotator for 00:30:00 at Room temperature Centrifuge the sample at 16000 x g, , for 00:10:00 at 4 °C Collect the supernatant in a clean tube: this fraction is enriched for nuclear chromatin-bound (Ncb) proteins. Flash-freeze this fraction and store at -80 °C Aliquot 50 uL of the supernatant and add 25 uL of 3X Laemmli Buffer with 100 mM DTT to monitor the quality of the extraction by western blotting. Flash freeze and store at -80 C. Post extraction of nuclear insoluble proteins pellet

steps.title: Homogenize tissue
steps.instruction: Weigh 100 mg of tissue and add to 1 mL Buffer CEB containing protease inhibitors. Homogenize with a tissue homogenizer until the tissue is completely disrupted and a uniform suspension is obtained.

substeps.instruction: Save a 50 µL aliquot of the homogenate.
Add 50 µL of 3× Laemmli buffer containing 100 mM DTT to the aliquot for western‑blot quality control.
Flash‑freeze the remaining homogenate and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Extract cytosolic proteins
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the homogenate at 5 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C. Collect the supernatant (cytosolic fraction) into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the cytosolic fraction and store at –80 °C.
Aliquot 50 µL of the supernatant and add 25 µL of 3× Laemmli buffer with 100 mM DTT for western‑blot monitoring.
Flash‑freeze the aliquot and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Extract membrane proteins
steps.instruction: Resuspend the remaining pellet in 650 µL Buffer MEB containing protease inhibitors and incubate on a tube rotator for 10 min at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge the suspension at 5 000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Collect the supernatant (membrane fraction) into a clean tube and flash‑freeze it; store at –80 °C.
Aliquot 50 µL of the membrane supernatant, add 25 µL of 3× Laemmli buffer with 100 mM DTT, flash‑freeze, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Extract cytoskeletal proteins
steps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 125 µL Buffer PEB containing protease inhibitors and incubate on a tube rotator for 20 min at room temperature.

substeps.instruction: If the pellet does not fully resuspend, pipette up and down with cut tips until disrupted.
Centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 10 min at room temperature.
Collect the supernatant (cytoskeletal fraction) into a clean tube.
Aliquot 50 µL of this supernatant, add 25 µL of 3× Laemmli buffer with 100 mM DTT, flash‑freeze, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Wash ECM‑enriched pellet
steps.instruction: Perform three washes to remove detergents before downstream digestion.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend the pellet in 600 µL PBS containing protease inhibitors.
Centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 3 min at 4 °C and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the resuspend‑centrifuge‑discard cycle two more times (total of three washes).

From the final wash, take 150–200 µL of the resuspended pellet, centrifuge at 16 000 × g for 3 min, and resuspend the pellet in 25–50 µL 3× Laemmli buffer with 100 mM DTT for western‑blot quality control.
Flash‑freeze the washed ECM pellet and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: Store ECM pellet
steps.instruction: Flash‑freeze the final ECM‑enriched pellet and keep it at –80 °C until needed for in‑solution digestion and mass‑spectrometry analysis.
